name: sgs/site-header-row
title: SGS Header Row
description: One row of a site header — an intrinsic never-overflow cluster of header elements (logo, nav, cart, etc.) that never wraps or stacks: every child shrinks to fit instead, at any width. Lives inside sgs/site-header.

flexWrap._comment: D455 — the header row is locked to ONE line and yields instead of wrapping. 'wrap' was the default until the authored @container stack rule was deleted from style.css; with that gone, wrap would trade a stack for an ambiguous 2-per-line arrangement. Read by SGS_Container_Wrapper (class-sgs-container-wrapper.php:622). No header pattern sets flexWrap explicitly, so this default governs every instance.

gap._comment: D455 (2026-08-02) — the fluid gap curve. CORRECTION caught in review: this attribute does NOT depend on the sgs_css_length_value() validator shipped the same session. gap is an OBJECT here, so render.php passes responsive_model:object and the value is emitted by sgs_emit_responsive_css() then sgs_responsive_sanitise_css_value() (helpers-responsive.php) — a PRE-EXISTING character allowlist that already permitted parentheses and commas. Verified by running that exact allowlist over this exact string: unchanged. The clamp would have rendered before the validator existed. The validator is load-bearing for the ~19 FLAT-scalar gap callers (card-grid, hero, gallery and friends), not for this one. Curve: 16px ceiling from container width 800px up, 8.5px floor at 267px and below, fluid between — measured 16px at 1400 and 8.56px at 320 against a fixed control that did not move. cqi is safe HERE because grid_on_inner is forced true for layout flex or grid (class-sgs-container-wrapper.php:528), putting gap on .sgs-container__inner whose ancestor container IS the row; a stored layout outside flex/grid would land it on .uid itself, where cqi cannot query its own container. Do NOT copy cqi to a block without a guaranteed container ancestor.
